name: Yakisoba

axes.label: What the town is known for

cells.noodle: Steamed, quickly cooled and coated in oil; low in water, firm; from four makers in the city
cells.topping: Nikukasu (pork back-fat left after pressing lard) and sardine powder
cells.marker: B-1 Grand Prix gold in 2006 and 2007; a 100-Year Food (fiscal 2021)

origin.era: just after the Second World War (said to be)

cells.topping: Cabbage and minced pork; a half-cooked fried egg on top, fukujinzuke on the side
cells.sauce: Worcestershire base with each shop’s additions; mild, not hot
cells.marker: A regional collective trademark; B-1 Grand Prix gold in 2009

cells.sauce: Each shop’s own; no common recipe described
